epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease cataloging metadata loss from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The backend MaterialEntity and Service must successfully persist cataloging metadata, including category and tags.

slices.title: Fix material cataloging persistence
slices.jtbd: When implementing material persistence for this epic, I want the backend to store category and tags fields, so that the collection remains accurate and organized.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a material payload with category and tags
When the material is submitted to the backend Service
Then the database successfully persists the category and tags fields
Given a persisted material with category and tags
When the material is retrieved via the API
Then the returned material payload contains the saved category and tags
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce failed catalog metadata saves from 100% to 0%

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized material modification incidents from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: The /api/materials endpoints must restrict write operations (POST, PUT, DELETE) to authenticated users.

slices.title: Secure material management endpoints
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to restrict material uploads and modifications to authenticated users, so that unauthorized actors cannot corrupt records.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated request to /api/materials
When attempting to execute a POST, PUT, or DELETE operation
Then the server responds with 401 Unauthorized
Given an authenticated request without the required role
When attempting to execute a POST, PUT, or DELETE operation to /api/materials
Then the server responds with 403 Forbidden
Given the need to verify these security constraints
When the associated *Test.java files are run
Then they explicitly test and pass for 401 Unauthorized and 403 Forbidden scenarios
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized API access from 100% to 0%
